ranked.description: Best first. Every figure is for one full use of the ash on `weapon_class`, never summed across variants.

hits.description: Damaging hits in one full use — every press of the ash, the (Lacking FP) rows excluded.

highest_motion_value.description: The biggest single hit — what optimal-affinity's attack_mv takes, when the hit is uniform across damage types.

default_affinity.description: The affinity it comes with. Not the set it accepts.

overrides_weapon_scaling.description: True when at least one hit replaces the weapon's scaling, which makes the weapon-optimal spread the wrong build for it.

priced.description: False for an ash with no rows in the hit table — a self-buff like Seppuku, which is real and does no damage of its own.

variants.description: The variant groups the table carries for this ash. Non-empty means the figures are for this weapon class and would differ on another.

rank_on_note.description: What the ordering means and what it leaves out. Say it in the answer.

considered.description: How many ashes passed the class and affinity filters.
